saints.name: St. Leonard of Noblac
saints.title: Hermit
saints.shortBlurb: A Frankish hermit near Limoges long invoked by prisoners and by women in childbirth…
biography: According to his medieval life, Leonard was a Frankish nobleman of the court of King Clovis who was converted and instructed by St. Remigius of Reims. Refusing worldly honours, he withdrew to the forest of Noblac near Limoges, where he lived as a hermit and gathered disciples, founding the monastery that bears his name.

He was renowned for obtaining the release of captives and prisoners, who by tradition brought their chains to his shrine, and for his intercession on behalf of women in labour. His cult spread widely across France, Germany, and beyond in the Middle Ages. He is a patron of prisoners and of expectant mothers.
saints.knownFor: Intercession for prisoners and women in childbirth.
